card.name: Start of drug names beginning with a
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that starts with a, such as amlodipine, avelumab, alogliptin or anagrelide, right after a word like on, of, with or receiving. Also fires on the middle of a few names such as enalaprilat and pentamidine isethionate.

modes.label: Opening a- of a drug name
modes.description: The letter a that begins a drug name after a linking word like on, of, receiving or with.
modes.example: Limit the dose of simvastatin in patients on<< a>>mlodipine to 20

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer drug name, where the name is split into parts.
modes.example: In such cases, enalap<<ril>>at injection should be promptly discontinued

card.plain: It marks the moment a drug name beginning with the letter a is just starting to be written out.
